lines.text: Three rules for living from the Lord's Prayer:
lines.card: THREE RULES FOR LIVING FROM THE LORD'S PRAYER:

lines.text: One. Confess all sins to God (Tell it) daily.
lines.card: 1. Confess all sins to God (Tell it) daily.

lines.text: Two. Surrender your will to God daily.
lines.card: 2. Surrender your will to God daily.

lines.text: Three. Forgive others and yourself daily.
lines.card: 3. Forgive others and yourself daily.

lines.text: Dear friend, rule one is the key to our success.
lines.card: Dear friend, rule 1 is the key to our success.

lines.text: When we can't do rule two or three, we must always go to rule one and confess it; God will forgive...
lines.card: When we can't do rule 2 or 3, we must always go to rule 1 and confess it; God will forgive...

lines.text: We must never stop confessing, even if they are the same old sins we can't seem to stop doing.
lines.card: We must never stop confessing, even if they are the same old sins we can't seem to stop doing.

lines.text: As we practice these rules everyday...
lines.card: As we practice these rules everyday...

lines.text: God will change our lives.
lines.card: God will change our lives.

lines.text: Also, practice the following little prayer all day:
lines.card: Also, practice the following little prayer all day:

lines.text: Lord Jesus, please pour out your mercy, salvation, and deliverance from evil upon everyone I see.
lines.card: Lord Jesus, please pour out your mercy, salvation, and deliverance from evil upon everyone I see.

lines.text: See The Other Side Of This Card For More Help.
lines.card: See The Other Side Of This Card For More Help.

lines.direction: THE TURN: the card turns (one transform) after the turn line, before the invite

lines.text: Dear friend, if you're not sure where you'll spend eternity, and you want to know now, please pray this simple prayer from the bottom of your heart; as he heard my prayer, He will hear yours also.
lines.card: Dear friend, if you're not sure where you'll spend eternity, and you want to know now, please pray this simple prayer from the bottom of your heart; as he heard my prayer, He will hear yours also.

lines.text: Dear Lord Jesus, I understand I am a sinner; I also believe You died for my sins and Your Father in Heaven raised you from the dead.
lines.card: Dear Lord Jesus, I understand I am a sinner; I also believe You died for my sins and Your Father in Heaven raised you from the dead.

lines.text: I simply ask You to have mercy on my life and save my soul.
lines.card: I simply ask You to have mercy on my life and save my soul.

lines.text: Come into my heart and my life and take me to Your home someday.
lines.card: Come into my heart and my life and take me to Your home someday.

lines.text: In Your Name Lord Jesus I pray and thank You.
lines.card: In Your Name Lord Jesus I pray and thank You.

lines.text: Amen.
lines.card: Amen.

lines.text: For continuous help from God, see other side...
lines.card: For continuous help from God, see other side...
